about.title: About
about.subtitle: The Human Behind the Code
about.pullQuote: “I engineer systems designed to survive reality — and build communities designed to leave no one behind.”
about.description1: Daniela Huezo is the engineer and consultora de IA en El Salvador, co-founder of Ai Labs, not the painter. She is an AI expert, a SpaceXAI Ambassador in El Salvador, an ElevenLabs Ambassador, and a Notion Builder in the Notion Builders Program. As a senior tech lead she ships AI products end to end, including Cerebryx and Smart Resume.
about.description2: But tech is only half the equation. Our industry's biggest bottleneck isn't bandwidth—it's access. That's why I spend my time off the clock building communities to help more women across Central America break into tech.
about.description3: When I'm not architecting systems or organizing events, you'll probably find me hunting for the best ramen in town, staying active, or losing track of time in Animal Crossing and Pokémon.

consulting.question: Is Daniela Huezo an AI consultant in El Salvador?
consulting.answer: Yes. Daniela Huezo is an AI consultant in El Salvador. Her consultoría de IA is the technical advisory she already publishes, together with asesoramiento técnico and consultoría de ingeniería, the 20 October 2025 masterclass at Universidad Don Bosco for graphic designers on SEO, analytics, and AI tools, and the AI products Cerebryx and Smart Resume.
